==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number," "story name" and "formatted name" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>PolyhedronCite|''ISSUE NUMBER''|''STORY NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}

*'''Note''': Formatted name is ''only'' needed when the episode name includes either italicization, or intentional parentheses. Otherwise, it should be excluded, as parenthetical descriptors are natively hidden.
